summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NEW Loyalty Punch Card and SMS/Email Messaging features. All 79 backend tests passed (100%), including 21 new tests for Loyalty (join, lookup, members, stamp, claim) and Messaging (send, history) endpoints. Frontend testing verified all new features work correctly: Landing page Loyalty section with join form and lookup, Dashboard Loyalty tab with members list and Stamp Visit buttons, Dashboard Messages tab with compose form and message history.
seed_data_creation: Test loyalty members created during testing (TEST_Loyalty_*, Test User Frontend, Test Lookup User, Test Stamp User, Test 10 Visits User, Test Claim User, Test No Reward User). Test message blasts created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Loyalty and Messaging features working correctly. LOYALTY: 1) POST /api/loyalty/join with name+phone creates member (returns already_member:false, visits:0), 2) POST /api/loyalty/join with same phone returns already_member:true with visit count, 3) GET /api/loyalty/lookup?phone=xxx returns member data (id, name, phone, visits, reward_earned, joined_at), 4) GET /api/loyalty/members with auth returns all members list, 5) PUT /api/loyalty/members/{id}/stamp increments visit count (returns visits, reward_earned, message), 6) PUT /api/loyalty/members/{id}/stamp at 10 visits sets reward_earned:true, 7) PUT /api/loyalty/members/{id}/claim resets visits to 0 and marks reward claimed. MESSAGING: 1) POST /api/messages/send with auth stores blast record (subject, body, channel, recipient_group) and returns result (email_sent, sms_sent, total_emails, total_phones, errors, message), 2) GET /api/messages/history with auth returns blast history. NOTE: SendGrid and Twilio are NOT configured - messaging will store records but report errors for missing config. FRONTEND: Landing page has Loyalty section with join form and lookup by phone showing punch card dots. Dashboard has 9 tabs including Loyalty (members list with Stamp Visit and Give Free Meal buttons) and Messages (compose form with channel/recipients selectors and message history). All existing features continue to work: login, analytics, specials, CMS content/menu editing, giveaway, catering inquiries, newsletter subscribers.
